messages:
maria: Heads up — p95 on the latency dashboard for /generate jumped after I toggled 'exclude retries'. Anyone see this? :confused:
aj: Yup. p50 stayed roughly the same but p95/p99 moved up a lot. Looks off compared to prometheus raw query.
seung: Which widget/query exactly? is the dashboard using tdigest rollups or raw samples?
meredith: It's the Endpoint Latency widget (latency_ms_rollup), mode=tdigest, exclude_retries=true. Screenshot I grabbed: https://redwood-internal/ss/abc123 (placeholder).
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary weight for route /generate -> 15% (2026-03-22T10:45Z)
sam: My hunch: the UI is toggling a client-side filter after fetching a merged rollup series, so percentiles are being recalculated on the wrong sample counts.
aj: If the UI is subtracting counts post-rollup, tdigest-based percentiles will be invalid. Percentiles must be computed on the filtered raw samples or a rollup computed for that exact filter.
seung: I can repro locally. Steps:
```
1) query raw samples for /generate with include_retries=true -> N=1200
2) same query with include_retries=false -> N=980
3) compute tdigest 95th on raw filtered samples -> ~180ms
4) UI shows ~230ms when exclude_retries=true
```
Looks like UI is displaying a percentile computed from a rollup that still includes retry samples (series merge) but using filtered sample_count elsewhere.
maria: Can we change the metrics API to expose rollup_series_id per tag slice? Right now UI asks for aggregated series only and can't request the slice that matches exclude_retries.
meredith: Minimal fix proposal: have /metrics/rollup accept filter params (include_retries/exclude_retries) and forward them to the rollup-joiner so we return a rollup computed for that exact filter. Also include sample_count in the response.
aj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1234 — modifies /metrics/rollup to forward filter tags and adds sample_count to payload. Needs review from eng-platform and eng-runtime.
seung: Also let's add a UI badge showing "percentile computed on: rollup/raw samples" so users know which path was used. Could save a lot of confusion.
maria: Agreed. Plan: (1) merge API patch + smoke canary tomorrow, (2) add UI badge + tooltip explaining rollup vs raw, (3) run a 7-day audit comparing p95 raw vs p95 rollup for top 50 endpoints and surface divergences. I'll file the tickets.
incident-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-4023 "rollup-filter-consistency for exclude_retries" assigned to eng-platform.
